sanskrit_verse:
ब्राह्मणश चैव राजा च द्वावप्येतौ धृतव्रतौ।
नैतयोरन्तरं किंचित् प्रजाधर्माभिरक्षणात्॥
transliteration: brāhmaṇaśa caiva rājā ca dvāv apy etau dhṛtavratau | naitayor antaraṃ kiṃcit prajādharmābhirakṣaṇāt ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The Brāhmaṇa and the King—both are bound by unshakeable vows; there is no distinction between them in safeguarding the Dharma of the subjects.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is unified when Dharma is the sole measure
Causation arises from shared responsibility in upholding Prajādharma
Restoration logic requires alignment of all custodians of Dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity holds custodial authority over Prajādharma THEN entity assumes equal responsibility as co-custodian
IF two or more entities perform Dharma-preserving functions THEN their functional equivalence overrides social categorization
IF Dharma-protection duty is invoked THEN punitive differentiation between roles is nullified
IF consciousness alignment is verified THEN capacity for restoration is equally distributed among aligned agents
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, where constitutional duties intersect with Dharma-preserving mandates, no precedence shall be granted based on caste, class, or office. All parties bearing the burden of Prajādharma shall be adjudged under a single threshold of consciousness alignment and functional equivalence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causality stems from collective commitment to Prajādharma, not individual agency. As per anupūrvaśaḥ, both Brāhmaṇa and King manifest sequentially within the same causal field of preservation. Their proportional responsibility aligns precisely due to shared alignment, eliminating punitive disparity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate joint completion process for Brāhmaṇa and King to reaffirm mutual Dharmic oath
Assign integrated oversight mechanism ensuring parity in Prajādharma execution
Establish consciousness audit protocol verifying absence of egoic hierarchy
Deploy integrity resonance system to restore energetic balance disrupted by perceived inequality
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling establishes unity of obligation between custodians of Prajādharma. There is no punishment, only realignment. Dharma stands restored. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
